summary: Apollo Infrastructure Company LLC filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to declare quarterly distributions on its Series I and Series II shares. The distributions range from $0.2111 to $0.2232 per share depending on the series and share class. They are payable to holders of record as of June 30, 2026, with payment expected on or about July 27, 2026, in cash or through the company's distribution reinvestment plan. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation. No M&A, tender, restructuring, or strategic event is involved. There is no deal to watch or risk-arb angle.
